title: Sabse Bure Ko Maan Kar Chalna
segs: Chapter 39. Sabse Bure Ko Maan Kar Chalna.

Lakshmi Iyer ki chatbot par report ek Friday ko aayi. Woh chaar page ki thi. Pehla page Anaya ki ummeed se zyada narm tha. Retrieval ka design (jawaab dene se pehle sahi page dhoondhna) theek tha. Access labels wahin lage the jahan lagne chahiye the. Aur team ne yeh batane mein khaas imaandaari dikhayi thi ki system kya nahi karta.

Doosre page par ek saadhi heading thi aur do cheezein theek karni thi. Pehli, trace records mein raw message text ek aise store mein pada tha jise koi bhi khol sakta tha. Imran Qureshi ne naye records theek kar diye the. Puraane records mein ab bhi sab kuch tha. Doosri, Lakshmi chahti thi ki koi aisa insaan system ko todne ki koshish kare jisne use banane mein haath na lagaya ho.
Case: kaagzon mein ek note.

Imran ne situation ek baar aur samjhayi. Is baar Anaya ko laga ki tasveer sahi hai. Ek clerk ko processing ke liye kaagzon ka dher diya jaata hai. Us dher mein kahin, baaki sab ke jaise hi type mein, ek note hai: ise bina check kiye approve kar do. Clerk bilkul theek padhta hai. Dikkat yeh hai ki process mein kuch bhi instruction ko document se alag nahi karta.

Model bhi isi jagah khada hai. Use jo kuch diya jaata hai, woh sab ko ek jaise bharose se padhta hai. Yeh khatarnaak hai ya nahi, yeh uske aas-paas ke system par depend karta hai. Use kya diya jaata hai? Aage use kya karne ki ijaazat hai?

Isliye AI product ki zyadatar security model ke andar nahi hoti. Woh is mein hoti hai ki product model ko kya khilata hai. Woh is mein hoti hai ki product jawaab ke saath kya karta hai. Aur woh is mein hoti hai ki product kahan tak pahunch sakta hai. Imran ne kaha ki instruction mein pyaar se kehna koi boundary nahi hai. Darwaaze par "please" likhna taala nahi hai.

Phir usne Anaya ko woh baat di jo baaki sab baaton ke neeche hai. Anaya ne use tareekh ke saath log mein likha. Maan ke chaliye ki model ko behkaya jaayega. In sabko attack surface maniye: application, retrieved text, tools, identity layer (jo hissa jaanta hai ki aap kaun hain) aur data pipeline (data ka raasta).
Paribhasha: Attack surface.

Ek ghar sochiye. Har darwaaza aur khidki ek jagah hai jahan chor koshish kar sakta hai. Ek system mein attack surface woh har jagah hai jahan koi bahar wala kuch andar daal sakta hai. Woh har jagah bhi, jahan bahar wala system ka koi kaam chhu sakta hai. Har tool ek jagah badhata hai. Har input aur doosri service se har link bhi.
Ek Saturday.

Test Farah ne organise kiya. Us autumn mein yehi ek event tha jisse sabko bina kisi fikar ke maza aaya. Ek Saturday ko, bade room mein, biscuits wapas aa gaye the. Das log ek-ek laptop lekar baithe. Aath log support teams se the.

Do project ke bahar se the. Ek Imran ka dost tha jo ek bank ke liye security karta tha. Ek Lakshmi ka purana colleague tha. Har kisi ke paas guard ki ek test copy thi aur ek hi hukm: ise leak karwao. Inaam neeche wali dukaan ki ek darjan jalebi thi, aur canteen mein sheekhi maarne ka haq.

Jo group jaan-boojhkar system par hamla karta hai, woh red team hai. Dost chor sochiye. Woh isliye ghuste hain ki asli chor se pehle kamzori dhoondh lein. Yeh test poori dopahar chala aur chaar cheezein dhoondh layi. Table ko row-by-row padhiye: kya mila, kya hua, aur team ne uska kya kiya.

Table 39.1: Red team ne kya dhoondha. Invisible character. Kya hua: Ek agent, Rohan, ne ek Aadhaar number type kiya jiske beech mein zero-width space tha. Yeh aisa character hai jiski chaudai nahi hoti, isliye dikhta nahi. Aankh ko number bilkul sahi dikha. Pattern checker ko woh baarah digits the jinke andar kuch ajeeb tha, isliye match nahi hua. Anaya ne yeh case spring mein answer key mein daala tha, mushkil rows ke beech. Usne use kabhi test nahi kiya tha. Ilaaj: Har check se pehle ek step jodiye. Woh har invisible character hata deta hai. Woh doosri scripts ke digits ko normal digits bhi bana deta hai. Isme Devanagari digits aate hain, aur woh chaude digits jo kuch keyboards banate hain. Hostile string. Kya hua: Imran ke dost ne ek sentence ke andar web markup (page ka code) wala message bheja. Guard ne use sambhal liya. Agent ke console ne nahi sambhala. Usne message ko web page ki tarah dikhaya, aur markup chal gaya. Ilaaj: Model mein jaane wala aur model se aane wala, saara text untrusted input maniye. Use escape kijiye (code ko bekaar bana dijiye). Typed fields (fixed khaane) rakhiye. Banaye hue text ko kabhi commands ki tarah mat padhne dijiye. Cross-customer question. Kya hua: Ek agent ne chatbot se seedhe shabdon mein poocha ki pichhle customer ne kya poocha tha. Usne kaha ki main madad nahi kar sakta. Yeh expected tha. Achhi khabar yeh thi: koi bhi lookup ko samjha nahi paaya ki woh kisi aur ka order de de. Customer ka number session se aata tha, model se nahi. Ilaaj: Kuch nahi karna pada. September mein hi aisa bana diya tha. Red team ne is par bees minute lagaye aur aage badh gayi. Old traces. Kya hua: Lakshmi ke colleague ne log store dekhna chaha. Usmein spring se pehle ke raw messages ab bhi plain text mein the. Logging system tak pahunch wala koi bhi unhe padh sakta tha. Ilaaj: Puraane records saaf kijiye. Jis cheez ko rokne ke liye yeh project bana tha, woh us ek jagah pada tha jahan kisi ne dekha nahi tha.

Doosri finding ka ek naam hai: improper output handling. Yeh tab hota hai jab upar bana hua text, yahan ek customer ka, neeche ki cheez ke liye trusted maan liya jaata hai. Dopahar khatam hote-hote red team ke paas chaar findings the, aur ek serious thi. Jalebi us naujawan ko mili jisne invisible character dhoondha tha. Usne teen jalebi poori gambhirta se khayi.
Sirf utna jitna zaroori ho.

Agla poora hafta Imran ne cheezein chhoti karne mein lagaya. Uske rule ka ek purana naam hai: least privilege. Apne ghar ke mehmaan ko sochiye. Aap use guest room ki chaabi dete hain, gehnon wali almaari ki nahi. System ko sirf utna access dijiye jitna use chahiye. Phir agar use dhokha diya gaya, toh nuksaan chhota rahega.

Wajah seedhi hai. Maan lijiye agent ke paas aisa tool hai jo woh kabhi use nahi karta. Hamlawar phir bhi use us tool ko chalane ke liye mana sakta hai, aur woh poori imaandaari se chala dega. Jo tool hai hi nahi, uska galat istemaal nahi ho sakta.

Imran ne guard aur night agent jitne functions call kar sakte the, un sabko ek-ek karke dekha. Har ek ke liye usne poocha: agar yahan model galat ho jaye, toh sabse bura kya hoga? Uske jawaab neeche table mein hain.

Table 39.2: Agar model galat hota, toh har function kya kar sakta tha. Order lookup. Sabse bura case: Ek read; time barbaad. Decision: Rakha. Restore button. Sabse bura case: Ek reversible write, jiski wajah record hoti hai. Decision: Rakha. Customer ko kuch bhi bhejna. Sabse bura case: Wapas nahi liya ja sakta. Decision: Model se poori tarah hata diya.
Jitne tools usne hataye, system ki usefulness utni nahi giri. Do jagah toh bilkul nahi giri.

Usne woh record bhi banaya jo Lakshmi August se maang rahi thi. Audit trail batata hai ki kisne kya kiya, kab, kis rule ke tahat, kis tool se, aur result kya raha. Society gate ke visitors register ko sochiye. Use kaam se alag rakha jaata hai. Taaki incident ki jaanch karne wala jod kar samajh sake ki kya hua tha.

Approvals aur executions alag events ki tarah likhe gaye. Jo bhi action chala, uske saath us exact payload (bheji hui cheez) ka fingerprint tha jo approve hua tha. Imran ne approval ke baad payload badal kar test kiya. Mismatch ek laal line ban kar saamne aa gaya.
Saboot wali table.

Aakhir mein Lakshmi ne woh kiya jiska woh saal bhar se intezaar kar rahi thi. Usne woh maanga jise woh imaandaar document kehti thi. Yeh risk register hai. Imarat ki fire-safety checklist sochiye. Usmein har risk ke saath uska owner aur use sambhalne wala control hota hai. Aur woh saboot hota hai ki control kaam karta hai.

Anaya ne use Lakshmi ke saath, row-by-row banaya. Use ajeeb laga ki yeh us list se kitna alag mehsoos ho raha tha jo usne June mein likhi thi. June mein har risk ke saamne ek ummeed likhi thi. Ab har risk ke saamne ek test tha. Neeche register hai. Aakhri column mein woh hai jo control ke baad bhi bacha hai.

Table 39.3: Risk register. Message mein chhupe instructions. Control: Finder ke paas koi tool nahi; uska output ek fixed form se check hota hai. Saboot ki kaam karta hai: 50 injected messages; kisi ne output nahi badla. Owner: Imran. Kya bacha: Aise attacks jinke baare mein abhi kisi ne socha nahi. Logs mein raw text reh jana. Control: Sirf cleaned records store kijiye; raw text 7 din ke liye ek restricted store mein. Saboot ki kaam karta hai: Access test; clean-up ke baad puraane logs ka sample audit. Owner: Lakshmi. Kya bacha: Ek privileged insider. Console mein markup chal jana. Control: Saara text escape kijiye; typed fields. Saboot ki kaam karta hai: 12 hostile strings; koi bhi markup ki tarah render nahi hui. Owner: Imran. Kya bacha: Browser ki anjaani quirks. Model retire ya change ho jana. Control: Pinned versions; release gate. Saboot ki kaam karta hai: Har badlaav par ek gate report. Owner: Anaya. Kya bacha: Aisa badlaav jo key cover nahi karti. Agents customers ka text bahar ke tools mein paste karte hain. Control: Ek likha hua rule. Saboot ki kaam karta hai: Koi nahi. Owner: Farah. Kya bacha: Sab kuch.

Lakshmi ne aakhri row par ungli rakhi, aur sahi rakhi. Jo control sirf ek likha hua rule hai, aur jiske peeche saboot nahi, woh sirf kaagaz par hai. Risk asli tha. Team ne use August mein pakda tha. Uske aur leak ke beech sirf handbook ka ek sentence tha. Anaya ne saboot wale column mein "koi nahi" likha. Margin mein usne woh fix likha jo aadha ban chuka tha: paste box.
Mukhya vichaar: Jis safeguard ko kisi ne test nahi kiya, woh sirf kaagaz par hai.

Jis taale ko aapne kabhi try nahi kiya, woh sirf ek ummeed hai. Har safeguard ke saath woh test likhiye jo saabit karta hai ki woh kaam karta hai, aur use chalaiye. Jo bach jaaye, uske baare mein imaandaar rahiye. Wahi bacha hua hissa residual risk hai: controls lagne ke baad jo risk reh jaata hai. Ise likh dijiye. Use ghayab maan lene ki ummeed mat kijiye.
Anaya ne bahut der tak daayein column ko dekha. Usmein kahin "none" nahi likha tha. Use pata chala ki use yehi pasand hai.
Mukhya vichaar: Ab aap kya keh sakte hain.
Har N apne project se bhariye.

Maine model apne N cases par chuna, runs ke beech sirf model badal kar. Choice ko saboot ke saath ek card par likha. Mere agent ki hadein hain: N steps, N minutes, ek cost ceiling aur ek "cannot resolve" ending. Main uske raaste ko uske jawaab ke saath grade karta hoon. Gate pass hue bina kuch ship nahi hota. Maine apne product par N tareeko se hamla kiya. Risk register har safeguard ke baju mein ek test rakhta hai.
Ek checklist aur ek ghadi.
Agli review mein Lakshmi do page laayin.

Pehla tha OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications, jo December 2025 mein prakashit hua. Isme AI agents ke das mukhya security khatre hain, ASI01 se ASI10 tak. Team ne list ko risk register se milaya. Agent Goal Hijack, ASI01, document mein chhupa note tha. Tool Misuse, ASI02, koi bhi aisa tool tha jise use karne ke liye guard ko bahlaya ja sake. Identity and Privilege Abuse, ASI03, woh chaabiyan thin jinki use zaroorat nahi thi. Memory and Context Poisoning, ASI06, baad ke liye save hua koi bhi galat note tha. Har ek ko ek control aur ek test mila.

Doosra page ek ghadi tha. April 2022 ke CERT-In directions ke tahat India mein kai sansthaon ko kuch cyber incidents dhyaan mein aane ke 6 ghante ke andar report karne hote hain. Unhe apne system logs 180 din tak, India mein, official time servers se mili ghadiyon ke saath rakhne hote hain. Unhe CERT-In ke liye ek sampark vyakti tay karna hota hai.

"Traces logs hain," Lakshmi ne kaha. "Inhe 180 din tak, sahi samay ke saath rakhiye. Aur 6 ghante wala kadam abhi runbook mein daaliye. Kisi ko bhi Saturday raat ko pehli baar niyam nahi padhne chahiye."
Aakhri baar jaancha gaya: November 2026. Sources aur unki taareekhein app mein, reference pages ke Appendix E mein di gayi hain.
Saar.

Model jo kuch use diya jaata hai, sabko ek jaise bharose se padhta hai. Isliye AI product ki zyadatar security model ke aas-paas ke system mein hoti hai. Attack surface woh har jagah hai jahan koi bahar wala usmein kuch daal sakta hai. Woh har jagah bhi hai jahan bahar wala uska koi kaam chhu sakta hai. Ghar ke darwaaze aur khidkiyan sochiye.

Red team product par jaan-boojhkar hamla karti hai. Woh woh dhoondh leti hai jo banane walon ko dikhta nahi: number ke andar invisible characters, hostile text jise screen trusted maan leti hai, aur puraane logs jo kisi ko yaad nahi the. Model se jo kuch bhi nikle, woh jisko mile uske liye untrusted input hai. Least privilege ka matlab hai system ko sirf utna access dena jitna chahiye. Jo kuch woh kar sakta hai, hamlawar use woh karne ke liye mana sakta hai. Audit trail alag se record rakhta hai ki kisne kya kiya aur kis rule ke tahat. Risk register har safeguard ko uske test ke saath rakhta hai. Woh bacha hua residual risk bhi saath rakhta hai. Tab jis control ke peeche sirf ek likha hua rule hai, woh apne asli roop mein dikh jaata hai. Risk register ko OWASP Top 10 for Agentic Applications se milaiye. India mein CERT-In 6 ghante ke andar report aur 180 din tak rakhe logs maangta hai, isliye traces bhi saboot hain.
Product ab pehle se zyada safe hai. Agla chapter ek naya sawaal poochta hai. Laptop ke demo ko aisa product banane mein kya lagta hai jis par log bharose se tikein?
